description: Organizations are overwhelmingly prioritizing reskilling existing workforces to work alongside AI, with 77% of global respondents planning this strategy.

instances.assertion: Organizations are overwhelmingly prioritizing reskilling existing workforces to work alongside AI, with 77% of global respondents planning this strategy.
A high percentage of organizations are planning to reskill their workforce to work alongside AI, indicating a widespread shift in labor requirements.
Organizations are prioritizing AI integration, with 77% planning to reskill existing staff and 69% hiring new AI-specialized talent.
Organizations are rapidly integrating AI, with 77% of global respondents planning to reskill their workforce to work alongside AI.
77% of organizations surveyed are planning to reskill or upskill their existing workforce to work alongside AI.
